snippet.title: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer Deep Dive - Future Games Show at gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4078430/STAR_WARS_Galactic_Racer/

Fuse Games dropped by the Future Games Show at gamescom for an exclusive interview digging into STAR WARS: Galactic Racer, the studio's run-based racing game where you control pod racers and land speeders. It's coming to PC & consoles on October 6.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
